key_points: Aksha is an intelligent surveillance system designed for automated monitoring with minimal human intervention.
Utilizes advanced technologies like Computer Vision, Artificial Intelligence, and Generative AI for real-time analysis.
Key functionalities include object detection, anomaly detection, and automated alert generation.
Offers multiple deployment architectures: On-Premise, Edge, and Cloud solutions.
Flexibility in UI and backend configurations to suit various operational needs.
Supports seamless integration with existing infrastructure for enhanced scalability.
Collaboration with NDIL led to the development of a customized version focused on worker safety.
Implemented a three-phase customization process incorporating Generative AI for enhanced features.
Successful proof of concept demonstrated on Raspberry Pi 4B with dual OS support.
Live recording and processing capabilities for real-time surveillance.
Advanced object detection for various entities including vehicles, personnel, and safety gear compliance.
Customizable alerts and insights generated using Generative AI for proactive management.
Clients report significant reductions in human monitoring efforts and enhanced event detection.
Positive feedback highlights the system's ability to identify abnormal events effectively.
Users appreciate the cost-effective nature of Aksha in enhancing existing CCTV setups.
Effortless scalability through microservices architecture using Kubernetes.
Real-time data processing capabilities ensure timely insights and actions.
High availability and fault tolerance achieved through decoupled architecture and distributed messaging with Kafka.
